note: Rustic campground on the south shore of 26-acre Emily Lake, five minutes west of Lac du Flambeau, with a paved boat landing (motors allowed) and a swimming area. Sites 2 and 5 sit on open ground under pines at the shore. The back-in sites were not designed for RVs and some are uneven for large rigs. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov information listing and its three site photos read. 11 FCFS sites, $15, no hookups/dump, vault toilets + hand pump, some 45 ft+, site 9 pull-through confirmed; season May 1-Oct 15 added (none stored). Lakefront KEPT with a caveat naming sites 2 and 5. Pin OK.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront KEPT (no change), caveat in the note. Official recreation.gov photos: site 5 is open pine-needle ground under scattered tall pines running straight to the lake about 20-30 m away with nothing between; site 2 likewise has the lake directly behind the table on open ground; site 6 sees the lake through trees. On Esri imagery (110 m half-width at 45.9652,-90.0095) the sites line the south shore with spurs roughly 20-30 m from the water and small sandy openings at the waterline. rec.gov lists 'Waterfront Sites'; the FS page says 'Most sites are near water with a view of the lake'. Sites are first-come nightly sites; the photos carry no lengths for 2 and 5 (the page says some sites are over 45 ft).

RIG FIT (soft): the FS page says 'Most sites are back-in and not specifically designed for RVs ... Some sites may be uneven for large RVs' but also 'some are over 45' long' and 'Site 9 is drive-through accessible' - a stated length well over 23 ft from the same agency, so no criteria problem; caveat kept in the note.
SEASON: none stored -> May 1-Oct 15 (FS page) added.
PIN: stored 45.9638,-90.0098 is on the entrance road ~85 m south of the loop; the FS point 45.964686,-90.010106 sits in the loop. Under 250 m - optional move to 45.9646,-90.0101.
PHONE: stored 715-762-2461 (Park Falls office of the Medford-Park Falls district); the Emily Lake page lists no office contact - not checked further, no change proposed.
LAKE SIZE: FS says 26 acres, recreation.gov 31 acres; note uses the FS figure.
